provenance: Reverse-engineered API conditioning & motion vector schema

prompt_architecture.attention_weighting: Action verbs placed within first 15 tokens. Heavy weight on optical lens descriptions (e.g. '35mm anamorphic prime lens, f/1.8 shallow depth of field, gentle chromatic aberration').

motion_stability_bounds.risk_note: Motion value > 0.7 triggers limb tearing and temporal warping in fast human motions.

negative_prompt_formula: morphing, text, watermark, bad anatomy, deformed fingers, low resolution, flickering, static frame, jumpy motion, blur, overexposed
